$comment: Single source of truth for every lab knob: query params, localStorage keys and share-link fields. `npm run codegen:lab-config` emits generated/lab-config.ts and the query-parameter matrix in docs/AGENTS.md; `npm run check:lab-config` fails on drift and on raw location.search / localStorage access outside src/config/. Precedence for every field: URL > share hash (#lab2= / #lab=) > localStorage > default. Field shape: key, type (bool | enum | number | int | string | list | setpoints), default, values + aliases (enum), min / max / exclusiveMin (number, int), url (aliases, first is canonical), storage { key, codec: bool | raw | int, values? (accepted from storage) }, share (goes in #lab2= links), live (applied without a reload), group, doc, docValues / docDefault (matrix text overrides).

fields.doc: Force backend. `webgl2` is **opt-in only** (not auto-fallback). A stored `seg-renderer=webgl2` is ignored for default boot (only a stored `webgpu` is honoured); `window.DEBUG_RENDERER` still sits between URL and storage.
Enable the C++ WASM plant (`seg-physics-bridge`). `wasm` is an alias. The debug-panel toggle persists it.
`0` keeps `LabSession.stepPlant` on the animation frame instead of the plant worker — A/B timing, or debugging the worker. See **Plant worker** above.
Deterministic RNG seed (Mulberry32) for particle init, telemetry and replay. Share links and experiments carry it.
Adapter / WebGL2 context `powerPreference: 'low-power'` (tablet / projector carts). Unset or any other value keeps the default boot.
Request the `timestamp-query` feature; enable queries in the debug panel after reload.
WebGPU canvas `colorSpace: 'display-p3'` (default `srgb` for CI screenshots).

`rgba16float` canvas with `toneMapping.mode: 'extended'` **only if** the display reports `(dynamic-range: high)`; bloom composite then outputs linear HDR (`outputLinearHdr`, extended sRGB encode in-shader) instead of ACES. Ignored with `color=legacy`.

WebGPU colour pipeline (#223): float scene / TAA / bloom mip chain, composite through the canvas `-srgb` view, authored colours decoded to linear, retuned look presets. `legacy` keeps the old 8-bit, no-encode path for one release. `getRendererInfo().colorPipeline` reports the formats — [`LIGHTING_RIG.md`](./LIGHTING_RIG.md#colour-pipeline-color-223).
WebGPU backbuffer scale vs exact device pixels (`devicePixelContentBoxSize`); the canvas is also clamped to `maxTextureDimension2D` — [`WEBGPU.md`](./WEBGPU.md). Clamped; `≤ 0` or unparsable is `1`.
WebGL2 `preserveDrawingBuffer: true` (also on when `navigator.webdriver`).
Screen-space reflections kill switch (the quality tier still gates SSR to high/ultra). `window.SEG_SSR_ENABLED` applies when the URL does not say.
Temporal AA kill switch (WebGPU only; the tier still gates TAA to high/ultra focus). `window.SEG_TAA_ENABLED` applies when the URL does not say.
Meter backend kill / force. `0` / `off` / `js` = JS goldens (stored `seg-gpu-chores=off` too). Never opens a second GPU API.
SEG layout pack. The layout control rewrites this param.
Heron vessel layout. The layout control rewrites this param and the stored preset.
SEG roller prototype look / lab effects. `window.SEG_PROTOTYPE_PRESET` applies when the URL does not say.
SEG structural frame complexity.
Default for **all** glTF CAD props (per-device, focus-only). A per-prop switch overrides it, so `?gltfHousing=0&gltfStand=1` shows one prop alone — [`GLTF_ASSETS.md`](./GLTF_ASSETS.md).
Coil former GLB; `0` skips that prop.
Stand GLB; `0` skips that prop.
Base plate GLB; `0` skips that prop.
Transformer C-core GLB (transformer focus); `0` skips that prop.
Van de Graaff terminal GLB (vdg focus); `0` skips that prop.

Heron glass vessels GLB (heron focus). Baked for `heronLayout=classic`; the other four presets re-route the plumbing, so the prop stays off there whatever this says — [`GLTF_ASSETS.md`](./GLTF_ASSETS.md).
Kelvin header tank + insulated collection jars GLB (kelvin focus); `0` skips that prop.
Thomson ring stand GLB — core, bobbin, rest shoulder, travel stop (jumping-ring focus). The ring itself stays procedural.
Lighting + post look. `lighting` is an alias; `window.SEG_LIGHTING_LOOK` applies when nothing else says.

Apply a **preset bundle** (look, explainer/coupling chrome, twin panel, residual gauges, post floor). An explicit flag (URL or share link) still wins at boot — see [Lab mode & setpoints](#lab-mode--setpoints). The header control remembers the last choice.
Classroom mode (large labels, reduced chrome), same switch as the explainer checkbox and `#lab=…;class=1`. Also keeps the explainer on screen under `labMode=showroom`.
Hardware twin mock transport (no serial port). Other links (`serial` / `bluetooth` / `usb`) are chosen from the Hardware Twin panel — each needs a user gesture for its chooser.
Clamp overview pipe flow by simulated lab power budget (`EnergyNetwork`). The pipe graph itself is `physics/coupling.json` → `generated/lab-coupling.{ts,h}` (ADR-0013 rider).

Feed a source device's simulated **B** estimate into a destination plant (`FieldNetwork`: `halbach-viz`→`hall`, `homopolar`→`hall` while Halbach is off, `mhd`→`lorentz-sled`), clamped to the destination's catalog range — ADR-0011. One live source per destination. Deliberately a **separate** switch from `energyCoupling`: one toggle cannot honestly claim both watts and tesla are live.

Seed the Kelvin inductor with the Van de Graaff sphere's potential at the bench, `V·r/d`, clamped to Kelvin's breakdown (`ChargeNetwork`: `vdg`→`kelvin`) — ADR-0013. A **third** separate switch: never implied by, and never implies, `fieldCoupling` or `energyCoupling`. Not a Laplace solve, not calibrated kilovolts.
Show the telemetry replay scrubber (load `.seg-replay.json` / CSV; plant step bypassed until you take over from a snapshot keyframe).
`0` kills the 2D wave slice (WebGPU panel **and** the WebGL2 micro-grid readout) — ADR-0010.
μ_r armature + copper turns in the wave slice. `0` reverts to the ADR-0010 vacuum kernel, for a side-by-side comparison — ADR-0012.

What modulates the slice's source amplitude: the pulse coil's discharge current, or the transformer bench's core flux (continuous AC). Winding *geometry* is unchanged; falls back to `coil` if that bench isn't in the lab — ADR-0012.
Lay the Halbach bench out as a linear array instead of a ring (read when the bench is created; share links switch it live).

Lab sonification (spark clicks, coil buzz, SEG drone, MHD flow bed). Arms the graph; an `AudioContext` still waits for a user gesture, and the header badge mutes it — [`LAB_AUDIO.md`](./LAB_AUDIO.md).
Embed mode: hide the dashboard chrome and accept the typed `postMessage` protocol from `embedOrigins` — [`EMBED.md`](./EMBED.md).
Origins allowed to drive an `?embed=1` lab over `postMessage` (exact `scheme://host[:port]` matches; `*` is refused). The parent page's messages from anywhere else are ignored.
Open the experiment panel on this reference experiment (`src/experiments/*.experiment.json`) — [`EXPERIMENTS.md`](./EXPERIMENTS.md).
Focused bench at boot (any catalog device id, or `overview`).
Operator drive (0–1).
SEG base field strength (0–1).
Explainer field multiplier B×.
Explainer annotation highlight id.
Play the focused bench's guided tour.
Tour step to open on.
Pinned catalog setpoints (`physics/devices.json` `setpoints[]`), clamped to each setpoint's range.
